items.source: A ResourceDescription that is customized based on a Description annotation.
items.translation: 一个根据 Description 注解自定义的 ResourceDescription。

items.source: HttpMethods that expose methods to create different ConfigurableHttpMethods.
items.translation: HttpMethods 用于暴露创建不同 ConfigurableHttpMethods 的方法。

items.source: SupportedHttpMethods that are determined by a CrudMethods instance.
items.translation: 由 CrudMethods 实例确定的SupportedHttpMethods。

items.source: A ResourceMapping that is backed by a Method.
items.translation: 一个由 Method 支持的ResourceMapping。

items.source: Central abstraction obtain ResourceMetadata and ResourceMapping instances for domain types and repositories.
items.translation: 中央抽象负责获取领域类型和存储库的ResourceMetadata及ResourceMapping实例。

items.source: Adapter class for the MessageSourceResolvable part of a ResourceDescription.
items.translation: 用于MessageSourceResolvable部分的适配器类，该部分属于ResourceDescription。

items.source: An API to discover the HttpMethods supported on a given ResourceType.
items.translation: 一个用于发现给定ResourceType所支持的HttpMethod的 API。

items.source: A filter to post-process the supported HTTP methods by Association resources.
items.translation: 一个用于对 Association 资源所支持的 HTTP 方法进行后处理的过滤器。

items.source: A collection of HttpMethods with some convenience methods to create alternate sets of those.
items.translation: 一组 HttpMethod，并包含一些便捷方法用于创建这些方法的替代集合。

items.source: Value object for a list of ParameterMetadata instances.
items.translation: 参数元数据列表的值对象。

items.source: ResourceMapping for all search resources.
items.translation: 为所有搜索资源提供 ResourceMapping。

items.source: SimpleResourceDescription that additionally captures a type to be able to potentially create a reasonable default message.
items.translation: SimpleResourceDescription，它额外捕获了类型信息，以便能够潜在地生成合理的默认消息。

items.source: A custom resource mapping for collection resources.
items.translation: 用于集合资源的自定义资源映射。

items.source: Configuration type to register filters customizing the HTTP methods supported.
items.translation: 用于注册自定义过滤器以支持特定 HTTP 方法的配置类型。

items.source: Configuration API to register filters to customize the supported HTTP methods by different kinds of resources.
items.translation: 配置 API 用于注册过滤器，以自定义不同资源类型所支持的 HTTP 方法。

items.source: A filter to post-process the supported HTTP methods by aggregate resources (collection or item resource).
items.translation: 一个用于对聚合资源（集合资源或单项资源）支持的 HTTP 方法进行后处理的过滤器。

items.source: Value object to capture metadata for query method parameters.
items.translation: 用于捕获查询方法参数元数据的值对象。

items.source: The strategy to determine whether a given repository is to be exported by Spring Data REST.
items.translation: 用于确定是否由 Spring Data REST 导出给定存储库的策略。

items.source: A variety of strategies to determine repository exposure.
items.translation: 多种确定仓库暴露的策略。

items.source: A description of a resource.
items.translation: 资源描述。

items.source: Mapping information for components to be exported as REST resources.
items.translation: 用于将组件映射为 REST 资源的映射信息。

items.source: Interface for metadata of resources exposed through the system.
items.translation: 系统暴露资源元数据接口。

items.source: An enum listing all supported resource types.
items.translation: 列出所有支持资源类型的枚举。

items.source: Null object to abstract the absence of any support for any HTTP method.
items.translation: 用于抽象对任何 HTTP 方法均无支持的空对象。
